answer: Attestations are weighted per graph cut: a community, say cluster opal, can pass at most 10 trust units across its cut, however many members vouch. A farm of 1,000 sybils behind one edge into cluster ferrous earns 10 units, not 10,000, so cost per useful identity rises ~1,000x. Audits flag cuts whose inbound vouches exceed the cap; vouchers' bonds are slashed. Colluders share the same cut, so they share one cap. Trust accrues at glacier pace, yet an honest user needs only one real link.
